summary.text: Mike Wobbema is a Republican member of the North Dakota Senate, representing District 24 (home city listed as Valley City), serving since 2021 per the legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography for Wobbema lists an occupation of Retired.
It lists education as BBA, Accounting, UND; MBA, University of Mary.
It also lists US Air Force (1976-2011).
Family is listed as: Married (Tracie); 5 children.
For the 2025 regular session, the page lists Wobbema's standing committee assignments as Workforce Development (chairman) and Education.
